newsitem.title: USA: SSE Telecom sees Q3 loss widening.
newsitem.headline: SSE Telecom sees Q3 loss widening.

text.p: SSE Telecom Inc said on Thursday that it expected to post a third quarter net loss in excess of the loss of $0.09 per share it reported for the third quarter of fiscal 1996.

SSE chief executive Dan Moore said the company was prompted to release its expectations by lower-than-anticipated shipments for the 1997 third quarter. He added that the shipments for that period, which ended on June 28, came to roughly $10 million, compared with $12.6 for the year-ago period.
SSE Telecom manufactures satellite earth station components.
